purpose: Independent semantic review of development-only authored contracts. No predictions/results/source or old expected labels provided.

contract.SMART: Deterministic field syntax; known scoped canonical subject can be named/excluded, ordinary about topics remain soft. High-confidence typo corrections may offer a correction; review whether hard enforcement or confirmation is semantically justified.
contract.TITLE_AUTHOR: Explicit literal Title/Author mode: match the supplied literal query against title/author. SMART grammar is not implicitly enabled in this mode.
contract.EXACT: Literal exact identity lookup. ISBN10/13 and OL work identifiers are accepted exact identifiers in SMART too.
contract.negative: Canonical subject exclusion must not automatically ban title/author/description text. Literal phrase/topic exclusions differ.
contract.review: Do not force one interpretation when wording genuinely admits multiple meanings. Preserve user meaning independently of current behavior.
